scope: Public primary-source review of representative direct and adjacent solutions. Not an exhaustive worldwide inventory or a hands-on test of licensed products.

notation.documented: Explicitly described in cited primary sources
notation.unknown: Not established by sources reviewed; not evidence of absence

solutions.name: project44 Ocean Visibility
unknown: Verified coverage and accuracy for chosen Caspian lane
Our API access and rights to historical training data
solutions.lesson: Preserve planned, estimated and actual times separately; show decisions at shipment-leg level.
solutions.access: Documentation can be read publicly; customer integration and data rights are not supplied to our team.

solutions.name: FourKites Dynamic Ocean
documented: Ocean functionality and several API modules require separately licensed add-ons
unknown: Our customer account and API entitlement
Accuracy on Caspian routes
solutions.lesson: Updates should be event-driven, idempotent and traceable; API documentation is not free access to operational data.
solutions.access: API key supplied by company administrator; licensing gates explicitly documented.

solutions.name: Shippeo Ocean Visibility
documented: Combines satellite AIS, shipping-line and schedule data
unknown: Whether advertised SLA applies to our cargo and lane
Access to required source feeds
solutions.lesson: A sea arrival ETA is insufficient: include discharge, inland handover and final delivery.
solutions.access: Commercial service; our account and integration terms not established.

solutions.name: Portcast
documented: Milestone-level ETA and explanations of delay causes
Waiting, dwell and traffic congestion metrics
unknown: Independent replication of advertised accuracy
Our lane coverage and licensed API access
solutions.lesson: Explainability and congestion maps already exist. Distinguish vessel waiting, cargo dwell and source disagreement.
solutions.access: API documentation is advertised; embedding requires credentials/token. No commercial data was accessed.

solutions.name: PortXchange Synchronizer
unknown: A ready integration in the selected Caspian ports
Transferability of results from other ports
solutions.lesson: Optimize a feasible port slot instead of blindly choosing earliest arrival; earlier is not always better.
solutions.access: Data sharing and participating port/operator feeds are prerequisites; not supplied to our team.

solutions.name: Awake.AI
unknown: Technical interface and data terms for our deployment
Performance under local Caspian conditions
solutions.lesson: A berth and terminal are constrained resources; the twin must model availability, not only draw vessels.
solutions.access: Vendor-led deployment. One guessed solutions URL could not be fetched; only retrieved pages support this entry.

solutions.name: Portbase Cargo Controller Import
documented: Combines shipping, terminal, customs and carrier information
unknown: A directly reusable solution for Caspian jurisdictions
Permission to access any real cargo dossier
solutions.lesson: Documentation readiness and trusted handover are operational constraints, not a separate decorative upload tab.
solutions.access: Paid service with connection requirements; the cited page lists an EORI requirement. No account was created.

solutions.name: MY.FESCO
unknown: A general third-party routing/prediction API for our project
Cross-carrier coverage beyond described services
solutions.lesson: Russian-language users already have shipment/document portals. Our advantage cannot be merely a personal account with a map.
solutions.access: Public tracking exists; full account operations depend on customer access. The help page was searchable but a later direct fetch returned502.

solutions.name: РЖД ЭТП Грузовые перевозки
documented: Online rail freight organization and ordering
unknown: Caspian vessel schedule and weather integration for our use
Team access to operational rail events
solutions.lesson: Treat rail events as one leg of a chain and distinguish an ordering platform from our experimental decision model.
solutions.access: Customer onboarding and contractual processes are described; reading API-related documents does not authorize real transactions.

solutions.name: SeaRates Logistics Explorer and tools
documented: Route, schedule, tracking, emissions and document API product families
unknown: Usable current rates and services for selected Caspian lanes
Our commercial API entitlement
solutions.lesson: Distinguish indicative tariff, actual quotation and bookable capacity; route geometry alone does not prove transport availability.
solutions.access: Token creation requires manager-provided identifier/API key; no live quote or booking was requested.

solutions.name: AnyLogic Ports and Terminals
documented: Simulation for berthing, yard, storage and multimodal terminal operations
unknown: An out-of-box calibrated Caspian operational model
Our site-specific parameters
solutions.lesson: Use simulation with explicit resource constraints and repeatable scenarios; model validity requires data and calibration.
solutions.access: Modeling platform; an organization must build/configure the model. A product page is not a ready dataset.

solutions.name: FlexTerm
documented: Port and intermodal facility digital twins
Berth, gate, rail and equipment scenario analysis
FlexSim CT was acquired and renamed FlexTerm
unknown: A ready model of selected Caspian facilities
Availability of a suitable runtime/license to our team
solutions.lesson: Avoid outdated product naming. A serious twin compares constrained operations and scenarios, not only a 3D visualization.
solutions.access: Specialized modeling product; site data, configuration and access still needed.

solutions.name: Kpler MarineTraffic data services
documented: Vessel positions and voyage information through API
unknown: Our paid/API access
Coverage quality at the selected berth/time
Link from a vessel to a particular authorized cargo
solutions.lesson: AIS positions are not container status or customs permission. Vessel presence alone cannot establish whether our cargo is ready.
solutions.access: API key is part of documented calls; no real vessel/cargo data was queried using external credentials.

standards_and_building_blocks.name: DCSA Track and Trace and Commercial Schedules
standards_and_building_blocks.use: Separate shipment, transport and equipment events; retain classifier/time provenance; schedules and tracking are separate domains. This review does not certify conformance.

standards_and_building_blocks.name: IMO Maritime Single Window
standards_and_building_blocks.use: Administrative ship/authority information exchange is an established concept. A demo package validation gateway is not a state maritime single window or customs release.

standards_and_building_blocks.name: GLEC emissions methodology
standards_and_building_blocks.use: Declare boundaries, transport activity, factor provenance, load assumptions and version. Sources show subsequent updates beyond3.1; do not call an old selected table the latest or claim certification.

standards_and_building_blocks.name: Open-Meteo
standards_and_building_blocks.use: Candidate source of timestamped wind/temperature forecasts with attribution. Forecasts are not berth observations or navigational authority; free API use terms need attention before commercial deployment.

standards_and_building_blocks.name: SimPy
standards_and_building_blocks.use: MIT-licensed process-based discrete-event simulation building block. It is not a ready predictive port service; useful as a reference for resources, queues and event clocks.
